cases.prompt: A monitored SavedVariables file changes while an import is being read. Make the flow reliable.
cases.expected: Use bounded stable byte snapshots and preserve retry ownership.
assertions: Require the existing two byte-identical reads and fingerprint the imported bytes.
Report an unstable read rather than importing a guessed snapshot.
Leave retry scheduling to C06 rather than looping indefinitely in C07.

cases.prompt: Prevent monitoring from repeatedly importing an unchanged file after an import completes.
cases.expected: Advance successful checkpoint state only on the correct terminal outcome.
assertions: Use C11 terminal receipts and successful C07 outcomes.
Do not mark failed, rejected or pending imports successful.
Preserve durable acknowledgement and retry behavior.

cases.prompt: A host shutdown times out while history work is active. Improve reporting.
cases.expected: Report timeout without falsely claiming database ownership was released.
assertions: Close admission and respect worker and lease lifecycle.
Keep native resources owned until active work unwinds.
Propagate the failure even if later disposal succeeds.
